frame: terrain pack local frame: x east, y north, metres from the tile's south-west corner; z = LOLA height (m)

encoding.geom: x_k = (x0 + sum(dx[:k])) / 10; y, z the same; n vertices; s_k = sum of the horizontal segment lengths of the decoded vertices up to k
encoding.f: f_k = sum(df[:k]) / 1e4 (0 at the start, 1 at the end)

speed_model: time per 5 m segment = ds / (slope_speed_factor * lighting_factor * (1 - slip(grade, phi 42 deg))); blocked segments (dig-in) take no time, as in tables.drive_profile
